# Big-Matrix Solutions

> Big-Matrix Solutions Ltd. is a software company based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. We build software for healthcare and business: AI diagnostics, hospital systems, SaaS platforms and e-commerce. More than ten of our systems are running in production, with five clinical partners and support around the clock.

Key facts:

- Legal name: Big-Matrix Solutions Ltd.
- Trade licence: TRAD/DNCC/011096/2026 (Dhaka North City Corporation)
- Registered office: Section# 11, Block# A, Mainroad# 3, Plot# 10, Pallabi, Mirpur, Dhaka - 1216, Bangladesh
- Email: contact@big-matrix.com
- Phone: +880 1339 870730
- Website: https://big-matrix.com
- What we do: AI diagnostics, hospital systems, SaaS platforms, industrial automation and software development services, sold and delivered online.
- Refunds: approved refunds are completed within 7 to 10 working days.

## Products

- [Auto Contouring Software](https://big-matrix.com/project/auto-contouring): Automatic organ-at-risk and tumour contouring with planning support, dose prediction and QA, across five cancer sites.
- [Big-Matrix Project Management Platform](https://big-matrix.com/project/bm-project-management): The board our own engineers run on: task tracking, deadlines and team coordination across every project in the lab.
- [DicomViewer](https://big-matrix.com/project/dicomviewer): A native Windows DICOM viewer in one small executable: 2D reading, measurements, 3D MPR and volume rendering, PET-CT fusion, angiography subtraction and PACS access.
- [Dosemetric](https://big-matrix.com/project/dosemetric): Web platform that schedules, records and signs off daily, weekly and monthly linear accelerator QA, with live tolerance checks and version-controlled forms.
- [IELTS Tutors](https://big-matrix.com/project/ielts-tutors): All four IELTS skills under real exam conditions, with live AI feedback and tracking that shows a candidate exactly what to fix next.
- [Lung CT Segmentation & Report Generation](https://big-matrix.com/project/lung-ct-report-generation): Nodule detection, volumetric segmentation and a drafted diagnostic report, wired directly into the radiology reading workflow.
- [Multimodal AI for Breast Cancer Diagnosis](https://big-matrix.com/project/nsu_ctrg_2021_2022_breast_cancer): Multimodal AI that segments mammograms and drafts the diagnostic report, turning raw imaging into findings a radiologist can act on.
- [RxCloud](https://big-matrix.com/project/rxcloud): One platform covering booking, consultation, prescription, records and billing — with staff approval and a public site per doctor.
- [Scriptor](https://big-matrix.com/project/scriptor): LaTeX, Word, PowerPoint, Markdown, whiteboards and PDF in one project, with one permission model, one version history, and AI agents that edit the file.
- [X-Ray Segmentation Editor](https://big-matrix.com/project/x-ray-segmentation-editor): Purpose-built annotation for X-ray imaging, giving clinicians a fast way to produce the labelled data diagnostic models depend on.

## Solutions

- [Agentic AI & LLM Application Engineering](https://big-matrix.com/service/agentic-ai-llm-engineering): Production LLM applications and agents that plan, call tools and run long tasks, with the verification, sandboxing and cost controls to deploy safely.
- [AI Engineering, MLOps & Model Assurance](https://big-matrix.com/service/ai-machine-learning): Custom models and LLM systems, the pipelines that keep them running in production, and the evaluation layer that proves a change actually helped.
- [Cloud, DevOps & Scalability Architecture](https://big-matrix.com/service/cloud-devops-architecture): High-availability cloud infrastructure, microservices architecture, containerization, and cloud-native deployment for enterprise-scale applications.
- [Computer Vision & Visual Inspection Systems](https://big-matrix.com/service/computer-vision-inspection): Defect detection, measurement and visual QA on the production line: edge-deployed, tolerant of real lighting, and tuned to the cost of each error type.
- [Data Engineering & Advanced Analytics](https://big-matrix.com/service/big-data-analytics): Ingestion, transformation and warehouse architecture with tested data quality, plus the predictive modelling and dashboards that sit on top of it.
- [Digital Hospital, Laboratory & Clinical Systems](https://big-matrix.com/service/digital-hospital-infrastructure): EMR, EHR, HMS, LIMS, RIS and pharmacy systems for hospitals and laboratories, with AI diagnostic support built into the clinical workflow.
- [Enterprise & SaaS Platform Development](https://big-matrix.com/service/enterprise-saas-platform): Multi-tenant SaaS platforms, ERP systems and workflow automation, with the tenancy, billing and operations work that decides whether they survive growth.
- [Industrial Automation & Smart Systems](https://big-matrix.com/service/industrial-automation): IoT-enabled systems, machine automation, predictive maintenance, and production optimization for modern manufacturing and industrial operations.
- [Medical Imaging AI, Radiology & Radiotherapy Planning](https://big-matrix.com/service/medical-imaging-ai-radiology): Segmentation, detection, automated reporting and radiotherapy auto-contouring across X-ray, CT, MRI and pathology, built to survive different scanners and sites.
- [Retrieval & Knowledge Systems (RAG)](https://big-matrix.com/service/retrieval-knowledge-systems): Question answering over your own documents, with hybrid search, reranking and citations, plus the evaluation set that proves it actually works.
